method_notes: LB Sutton community school admission arrangements 2026/27 s4.3.4: distances measured in a straight line from the child's home address to the main entrance of the school building, using the computerised Geographical Information System maintained by the Sutton Admissions team. Ties broken by drawing lots. Hackbridge Primary measured to mid-point between its two sites' main entrances. Starting School booklet 2026 notes other admission authorities may measure to 'the entrance of the school' or 'the front door'.

Tables give only the furthest distance, not which criterion it was reached under. 'N/A' for VA faith schools interpreted as no distance-based cut-off (places by faith criteria). Individual VA/academy distance-point variations not researched per school. 2024 table year inferred from 2025 booklet 'last year' label. Junior schools excluded.
